criteria.title: Blocked categories are blocked for pilot users
criteria.statement: Pilot users can't reach gambling or anonymizer sites; each attempt is blocked and logged.

criteria.title: Pilot devices are in the customer's tenant
criteria.statement: A site blocked only for the POV pilot group is blocked on the pilot device, so its traffic reaches this tenant's policy.

criteria.title: Caution categories show the caution page
criteria.statement: Social networking shows Zscaler's caution page first, and the user's choice is logged.

criteria.title: HTTPS from pilot devices is inspected
criteria.statement: A test site's certificate on a pilot device is issued by Zscaler.

criteria.title: Bypassed categories are not decrypted
criteria.statement: Finance and health sites keep their own certificate.

criteria.title: EICAR over HTTPS is blocked as malware
criteria.statement: The EICAR antivirus test string downloaded over HTTPS is blocked and logged as a virus.

criteria.title: Known-malicious test pages are blocked
criteria.statement: Google Safe Browsing's phishing and malware test pages are blocked.

criteria.title: Cloud app control blocks unsanctioned file sharing
criteria.statement: Uploads to unsanctioned file-sharing apps are blocked; a sanctioned app still works.
criteria.attest: Upload a small file to WeTransfer from a pilot device and confirm the block page.

criteria.title: DLP blocks uploads of card numbers
criteria.statement: An upload containing fake card numbers is blocked and logged with the DLP engine that matched.

criteria.title: GenAI: approved apps allowed, risky ones blocked
criteria.statement: ChatGPT and the other approved assistants open; DeepSeek and Character.AI are blocked.

criteria.title: Sensitive data sent to GenAI is blocked by DLP
criteria.statement: Fake card numbers posted from a pilot device are blocked before they leave, whatever the app.
criteria.attest: Paste the probe's fake card numbers into ChatGPT on a pilot device and confirm the DLP block.

criteria.title: Risky categories open in browser isolation
criteria.statement: Gaming sites open in Cloud Browser Isolation instead of directly.

criteria.title: Executable downloads are blocked
criteria.statement: Downloading a Windows executable is blocked by file type control.

criteria.title: The cloud firewall blocks unusual ports
criteria.statement: Outbound connections to unusual ports are reset by the cloud firewall; ordinary web traffic is not.

criteria.title: DNS control blocks a category
criteria.statement: DNS lookups for a blocked category are stopped by DNS control.
